tools.name: search
tools.description: Public Job Postings JSON Endpoint for ONE company's careers site (config company_subdomain): GET https://{company-subdomain}.pinpointhq.com/postings.json, which 'returns all job posting[s] for each job as they appear on your career site' (no auth). location is sent as location_city_state_name ('filter by city/state name of the location', comma-separated values OR'ed, e.g. 'San Francisco, CA' or 'London'). There is no keyword or paging parameter, so query/page/limit are not sent: every posting comes back in one response — filter client-side and do not request further pages. Compensation fields are null unless compensation_visible; compensation_frequency, employment_type, workplace_type, deadline_at, department/division, job{} and the benefits/responsibilities/skills HTML sections are in raw. Pinpoint also hosts an MCP server for its authenticated ATS API (https://developers.pinpointhq.com/docs/mcp).
